vercel-mcp-api.$comment: Identifies requests to the Vercel hosted MCP server (mcp.vercel.com).

vercel-mcp-session.$comment: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Vercel content.

vercel-mcp-read-all.$comment: Run any read-only Vercel MCP tool (teams, projects, deployments, build and runtime logs, observability, Web Analytics, domains and DNS, environment variables, feature flags, firewall, Global Config, integrations, routing, sandboxes, storage, CI, agent runs, toolbar threads, docs) plus the MCP session handshake.

vercel-mcp-write-all.$comment: Run any Vercel MCP tool that creates or changes something (projects, deployments, promotions and rollbacks, domains, DNS, purchases, environment variables, feature flags, firewall, Global Config, connectors, KMS keys, routing, sandboxes and command execution, storage, Drains, toolbar threads, CI retries, feedback) plus the MCP session handshake.

vercel-mcp-read-teams.$comment: Look up the signed-in user, their teams, team members, access groups and the team activity log (get_auth_user, list_teams, list_team_members, list_user_events, list_access_groups, ...).

vercel-mcp-read-billing.$comment: View the team's billing charges and contract commitments.

vercel-mcp-read-projects.$comment: List and inspect projects, their settings, deployment protection, project domains, microfrontends configuration and the Git repositories/namespaces available to link (list_projects, get_project, git_namespaces, search_repo, ...). Includes get_project_deletion_link, which only returns a dashboard link.

vercel-mcp-read-deployments.$comment: List and inspect deployments, their build logs, events, files, feature flags and deployment cards, and fetch content from a deployment URL (list_deployments, get_deployment, get_deployment_build_logs, web_fetch_vercel_url, ...).

vercel-mcp-read-rolling-releases.$comment: View the active rolling release, its configuration and billing status, and the aliases of the current promotion.

vercel-mcp-read-observability.$comment: Read runtime logs, grouped runtime errors and request traces, query observability data and its schema, and inspect configured Drains (get_runtime_logs, get_runtime_errors, create_observability_query, list_drains, ...).

vercel-mcp-read-analytics.$comment: Query Web Analytics: count and aggregate page views and custom events for a project.

vercel-mcp-read-domains.$comment: List and inspect domains, DNS records, certificates, domain orders and verification status, and check domain availability and prices, including read-only purchase quotes (list_domains, get_records, search_domains, get_purchase_quote, ...).

vercel-mcp-read-env-vars.$comment: Read project and shared environment variables, including their decrypted values, and inspect custom environments (filter_project_envs, get_project_env, get_shared_env_var, ...).

vercel-mcp-read-feature-flags.$comment: List and inspect feature flags, flag segments, flag versions, flag settings and SDK keys.

vercel-mcp-read-firewall.$comment: Read the firewall configuration, system bypass rules and active attack data.

vercel-mcp-read-global-config.$comment: Read Global Configs (Edge Config): their items, read tokens and backups.

vercel-mcp-read-integrations.$comment: Inspect integration configurations, products and billing plans, webhooks, and the connectors linked to the team's projects.

vercel-mcp-read-routing.$comment: View routing rules, redirects and their version history, deployment aliases, and draft a routing rule from a natural-language description without saving it (list_project_routes, list_bulk_redirects, list_aliases, generate_route, ...).

vercel-mcp-read-sandboxes.$comment: Inspect sandboxes and sandbox sessions: list sessions, commands, snapshots, read command output and read files inside a sandbox.

vercel-mcp-read-storage.$comment: Inspect Blob stores, build cache artifacts and Remote Caching status.

vercel-mcp-read-agent-runs.$comment: Inspect runs of agents built with eve: run status, usage and traces.

vercel-mcp-read-ci.$comment: Inspect Vercel CI invocations, attempts, job definitions, job runs, tasks and their logs.

vercel-mcp-read-toolbar.$comment: Read Vercel Toolbar comment threads and their messages.

vercel-mcp-read-docs.$comment: Search the Vercel documentation and get guidance on Vercel CLI commands.

vercel-mcp-write-projects.$comment: Create projects (from scratch or from a Git repository), change project settings, pause or resume projects, add and verify project domains, accept project transfers, and change deployment protection and protection bypass (create_project, create_git_project, update_project, pause_project, ...).

vercel-mcp-write-deployments.$comment: Create deployments from Git or uploaded files, deploy inline files or a Claude Design bundle, cancel deployments, create shareable links to protected deployments and re-request deployment checks (create_deployment, deploy_to_vercel, upload_file, cancel_deployment, ...).

vercel-mcp-write-rolling-releases.$comment: Change which deployment serves production traffic: promote or roll back a deployment, start, advance or complete a rolling release, and change rolling release settings (request_promote, request_rollback, start_rolling_release, ...).

vercel-mcp-write-domains.$comment: Add or transfer domains to the team, create, update or replace DNS records, and issue certificates.

vercel-mcp-make-purchases.$comment: Spend money on behalf of the team: register (buy) domains and, where still exposed, buy a Pro plan, prepaid credits or add-ons (buy_domain, buy_domains, buy_single_domain, buy_pro, buy_credits, buy_addon).

vercel-mcp-write-env-vars.$comment: Create and edit project environment variables.

vercel-mcp-write-feature-flags.$comment: Create and update feature flags, flag segments and flag settings, and create SDK keys.

vercel-mcp-write-firewall.$comment: Change the firewall configuration and toggle Attack Challenge mode.

vercel-mcp-write-global-config.$comment: Create and update Global Configs (Edge Config), change their items in batch, create read tokens and restore backups.

vercel-mcp-write-integrations.$comment: Change connector settings and connect connectors to projects or change the environments they are available in.

vercel-mcp-write-key-management.$comment: Create and update KMS issuers and issuer policies, and create, activate or revoke signing keys.

vercel-mcp-write-routing.$comment: Add, edit and stage routing rules and redirects, promote, restore or discard their versions, assign aliases and change URL protection bypass (add_route, stage_routes, stage_redirects, assign_alias, ...).

vercel-mcp-write-sandboxes.$comment: Create and manage sandboxes: run commands and kill them, write files and create directories, take snapshots, extend timeouts, change network policy and stop sessions (create_sandboxes_v4, run_session_command, write_session_files, ...).

vercel-mcp-write-storage.$comment: Create Blob stores, upload build cache artifacts and record cache events, and invalidate cached content by tag or source image.

vercel-mcp-write-observability.$comment: Create, update and test Drains that send observability data to external destinations, and mint trace session tokens (create_drain, update_drain, test_drain, create_trace_session).

vercel-mcp-write-toolbar.$comment: Reply to Vercel Toolbar comment threads, edit messages, add reactions and resolve or reopen threads.

vercel-mcp-send-feedback.$comment: Send feedback about Vercel to Vercel.
